t: The Time Cat 6 Grey Ethernet cable in a 305m box provides extended cabling for large-scale network installations. This unshielded cable features colour-coded, twisted copper cores rated for 10-gigabit ethernet applications, with grey PVC sheathing suitable for indoor environments. The 70°C temperature rating and substantial length eliminate frequent splicing, reducing installation time and maintaining signal quality across complex building networks.
